**Result: COMPLIANT at the preferred level** — no redline proposed.

The Agreement contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding the Issuer or Depositor. The three appointment clauses (Servicer, Custodian, Marketing Agent) are engagements only, with no "sole", "exclusive", or requirements-purchase language, and the Successor Servicer provisions expressly preserve our freedom to engage a different servicer. The only instances of "exclusive" either benefit our party (Issuer's exclusive control of the Cap Collateral Account) or are unrelated (nonexclusive jurisdiction).
